brandBasis.source: Box: Administrative / Forms & Templates / Electronic letterhead / archive / 2026 SVBC updated letterhead art 6.2.2026.docx (file 1346312091954)
brandBasis.note: The letterhead is the basis for the brand; the website and Workers migrate to it over time.

tokens.name: svbc-black
tokens.usage: Brand black. Fixed in both themes: website header bar, table headers, active tab, email header band, member card; text on svbc-gold. The letterhead itself uses svbc-grey, not black, for its chrome.

tokens.name: svbc-gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold, from the 2026 letterhead (tagline text; the logo bubble). Fixed in both themes. Fill of primary pill buttons with svbc-black text (11.5:1), links and accents on svbc-black / svbc-chrome, section bands, focus ring on dark surfaces (on a light page the ring is svbc-ink). Never text on white or sand (1.8:1); the letterhead's gold tagline on white fails AA, keep it decorative and repeat its words elsewhere. Website and Workers still use web-gold #ffc700: migrate.

tokens.name: svbc-grey
tokens.usage: Brand grey: the logo's box and bicycle on the letterhead (sampled from its artwork). White text on it is 4.6:1 (AA). Headers, footers and bands where the website now uses svbc-black or svbc-chrome, as the org migrates.

tokens.name: svbc-grey-text
tokens.usage: Letterhead contact block, board list and 501(c)(3) line. Flag: 4.1:1 on white, below AA for its 9pt size, and 3.5:1 on svbc-sand. Kept as the letterhead has it; for new body or small text use svbc-ink or text-muted.

tokens.name: web-gold
tokens.usage: Legacy: the website and Workers gold before the letterhead became the brand basis (2026-11-19). Don't use in new work; replace with svbc-gold as surfaces are updated.

tokens.name: svbc-white
tokens.usage: Brand white. The logo's lettering; text on svbc-black, svbc-grey and the member card.

tokens.name: svbc-chrome
tokens.usage: Footer bar (website darkAccent #383838). Always dark. White text, gold underlined links. Workers code uses #303030 for both header and footer: header moves to svbc-black.

tokens.name: svbc-ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text (#303030, the website's). Light-theme value of text. The letterhead's letter body is plain black; either reads.

tokens.name: svbc-sand
tokens.usage: Warm light ground: the letterhead's sidebar band. Alternate sections behind svbc-ink text (11.2:1); email wrap. The website still uses #f4f4f3: migrate.

tokens.name: chrome-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the member card (meta labels). Footer copy on the website is svbc-white, not this.
